YOGAN RETURNS
You guys voted for it... Yogan is back for 2 weeks!
He leaves again on 2026年12月6日星期日 00:30. Get him while you can!

THANKSGIVING BUNDLE
Brand new limited time bundle!
Turkey Stampede score effect (turkeys run the other team over!!)
Thanksgiving Dinner collaborative emote (up to 5 players)
Roast Turkey player card

RIKU BUFF - REBOUND now needs 1 less spike to charge

2x Lucky Weekend AND 2x Lucky Thanksgiving!
ANOTHER 2X Luck event incoming so y'all can get the styles & abilities you want, this time we're doing an extra day for Thanksgiving!
FROM 2026年11月22日星期日 00:30 to 2026年11月24日星期二 00:30
AND ON THANKSGIVING: FROM 2026年11月26日星期四 13:00 to 2026年11月27日星期五 13:00
SECRET PITY IS HALVED: 200 -> 100
SECRET STYLE/ABILITY CHANCES ARE DOUBLED: 0.5% -> 1%

LUCKY STYLE/ABILITY SPIN HANDOUT
LUCKY STYLE/ABILITY SPINS ARE BEING HANDED OUT from 2026年11月21日星期六 23:30 to 01:30
Every 10 mins!!!
13 lucky spins total...

NEW CODES
UPDATE_97 = 5 Lucky Style Spins
YOGAN_RETURNS = 5 Lucky Style Spins
TURKEY_STAMPEDE = 5 Lucky Ability Spins
